outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial cluster map image, not a statistical plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel B shows H&E images with manual region annotations; it is not a statistical plot and has no significance symbols.
Panel C shows H&E and spatial gene expression heatmap images; it is not a statistical plot and has no significance symbols.
GSEA enrichment plots report exact NES, FDR, and p values directly on the plot rather than using significance symbols (e.g., asterisks), so there is nothing requiring a symbol-legend definition.
The bar graph displays exact p-values printed above each bar rather than significance symbols, so no symbol definition is needed.
